correctness.rationale: Exact pmf normalization follows by telescoping of F(j+1)-F(j); when alpha<=1 its parent density decreases. For alpha>=1 the parent log-density has strictly negative second derivative, and a double-integral majorization inequality proves strict log-concavity of all bin masses. The density likelihood ratio f_beta/f_alpha increases in x for beta>alpha, so each neighboring mass ratio crosses one exactly once as alpha grows; strict log-concavity orders crossings. Finally tanh log-expansion provides a uniform compact-gamma limit H(gamma) with a unique simple positive root, yielding alpha_k exp(-k theta)=C+O_theta(exp(-2k theta)). checker.py passed 484 finite decimal diagnostics, ancillary to the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The full exact modal phase diagram is a natural and previously unresolved structural question for a published two-parameter count model whose practical use depends on which bin is most probable. The theorem characterizes all observable modal transitions, rules out skipped bins and separated ties, and gives a sharp exponential large-index threshold with a new computable coefficient. This is more than the isolated alpha_0 example already printed in the source, and does not depend on an asserted downstream application.
